## Description

Describe the bug clearly and concisely.

## Steps to Reproduce

Explain what you did, in order, so the issue can be reproduced. Include the page, feature, or command involved.

## Expected Behavior

Describe what you expected to happen instead.

## Actual Behavior

Describe what actually happened, including any error messages.

## Environment

Note the browser, operating system, and any relevant version details.

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, logs, or anything else that helps explain the problem.
